basis.ordering_convention: PBW: kappa < [a_1^+ block: E_eps1_del{k}_pp (k=1..n), E_eps1_del{k}_pm (k=1..n)] < [a_1^- block: E_eps1_del{k}_mp (k=1..n), E_eps1_del{k}_mm (k=1..n)] < [even: H_k, positive roots, negative roots, mixed roots]  (K=1 excluded)

kappa.label: kappa
kappa.description: Odd nilpotent central element; coefficient in deformed brackets (Schema 2)

K.label: K
K.description: Even central identity; excluded from PBW basis

gb_matrix.ordering: Option A (interleaved): cols = b_1^+, b_1^-, b_2^+, b_2^-, ...

metadata.description: Schema 2: inhomogeneous deformation γ(X,Y) for C(n+1) = osp(2|2n). Each entry {X,Y,Z,gb,coeff} records γ(X,Y) ∋ coeff·gb·Z so that [X,Y]_γ = [X,Y]_0 + κ·γ(X,Y). Z="K" entries denote the even central element K=1 (arising from CCR constant terms when b_k^- b_k^+ = b_k^+ b_k^- + 1).
